collection.title: Toyota Previa/Estima 2000 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Toyota Previa 2000 to 2006 requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Heavy Duty Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Previa which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
